Author: The Kinship
Name: Rafter Cat's Vogue Studio
Punchline: Simple click-and-drag posing for GPose: click a body part, drag it where you want.
Description: Big, easy-to-hit circles on your character's joints in GPose. Click a body part and drag it with the mouse, no gizmos. Works together with Brio, which holds the pose and still handles hands, feet and fine detail. Type /vogue to open.
